`WhatIfDiscovery.ps1` is the unchanged Conditional Access What-If test from the
MIT-licensed Maester 2.3.0 PowerShell Gallery package. Its normalized SHA-256 is
`4EAFA3104AA711BB186E0633AC1EF8BA9074F9160AF8573D35570559B03BA384`.

Source: https://github.com/maester365/maester
Package: https://www.powershellgallery.com/packages/Maester/2.3.0

The fixture lets offline tests reproduce scalar collection discovery failures
using the real bundled tests, without authenticating or calling Microsoft Graph.
